findings.text: `login_location` is added without the `DEFAULT ''` that `init.sql:252` has, so existing and new rows default to NULL where a fresh install has ''. Nothing breaks today, but the schemas drift. Suggest adding `DEFAULT ''::character varying` to match.

When a login hits `SESSION_TRANSITION`, nothing is written to the login log, neither success nor failure, so the audit trail has no record of that attempt. Suggest logging it as a failure with a message like "会话切换中" but without calling `recordLoginFail`.
